what: The proposed pause checkpoint resolves ISSUE_NUMBER from source-env.sh via phase_driver_session_get, but source-env.sh is written as export ISSUE_NUMBER=... while phase_driver_session_get only matches bare KEY= lines.
scenario_or_breakage: If .pause-requested appears after the driver starts, before snapshot or validator, the checkpoint fails to resolve the issue and exits 2 instead of execing design-pause-save.sh, regressing the pause contract the extraction is meant to preserve.
suggested_fix: Use inherited ISSUE_NUMBER from the orchestrator prelude first; if absent, source $DESIGN_TMPDIR/source-env.sh or add an explicit export-aware parser. Add the pause harness fixture with export ISSUE_NUMBER=... so this path is covered.
